_comment: Static code-entry seeds for bank $17 (serve-volley drill / menu bank): 5 stranded code blobs + $478e (code after a 9-byte OAM header at $4785). Function starts + internal flow targets. The uniform position/animation record arrays and LZ graphics are data. Flat = 0x17*0x4000 + (cpu-0x4000). Second pass: 10 more cursor/menu handler blobs ($4016-$4443). NOTE: $6fdb/$6fee/$7001/$7012 were removed 2026-07-24 -- they followed a garbage decode of the rules-page data at $6fdb-$709a (MinigameRulesTextIdBases_17 + MinigameRulesPageLists_17). | Correction (static-seed over a table): $40bd is the 16-byte hVBlankCounter&$0f offset table the code at $40a3 reads; the routine starts at $40cd (byte-identical to $1b:$40f7 and $38:$40cf for 911 bytes). | Correction (static-seed over a table): $4a75 is six 6-byte records ($4a5a indexes them by a*2+c and reads word pairs), not code; the routine starts at $4a99. | Correction (static-seed over a table): $46c2 is 8 unreferenced bytes between the ret at $46c1 and the 12-word ramp at $46ca that $46a2 indexes; seeding it decoded both as code. | 2026-07-29: $43b9 and $43cb are the two-instruction prologues (ld d,$00 / ld a,c) of the twin linear-index-to-grid divides whose loops at $43bc/$43ce were already proven -- the entries were never executed, so 3 bytes of each routine read as data. $4a1b is a 14-byte routine (ld c,$04 / ld b,$09 / ld hl,$4a29 / ld de,$2020 / call QueueSpriteTemplate / ret) whose sprite list sits at $4a29.
